Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Have had this grill for only two months. A chef and professional cook for over 15 years I've owned and/or used a lot of propane grills, and have always appreciated Webber. The Compact size is perfect for the corner of a small deck and family of 4. The three burners with 5 distribution plates leaves two very narrow very minimal cool spots, though this thing heats up FAST and can be controlled quite accurately from 300 to 500 degrees. Putting it together wasn't as easy as many other grills, but the end result was worth the extra effort. The folding side tray is opposite the wheels and because the tray seats using a pop up key hole on a cleat screw, lifting that end always leads to the tray becoming unseated, making moving the grill very awkward (even unsafe when hot). 2 castors opposite the wheels or a simple locking pin on the tray would have made this a non-issue (WEBBER~I'll be altering mine). Lastly the upper level is such a tight fit it bows upward a bit and often unseats while grilling. And it's very narrow making it unusable for roasting veggies in a tray or even keeping a few larger steaks off the direct heat. Would have preferred a pivoting tray, this one's mostly just in the way.

Overall though this is a very good compact to midsize BBQ that I'm sure will last a very long time. Aside from two or three issues, I can't imagine anyone regretting this purchase.
Results.Title: Very Good Almost Great

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Weber cares about two things: Build quality and grilling quality. The build quality of this grill is quite amazing. It is the reason Weber gives a 10 year warranty. It is very well built with heady duty components meant to last.

The grilling quality is equally impressive. Lesser grills have a hard time reaching temps above 400 degrees, essential for grill steaks. This grill easily achieves 500 degrees if needed. We have cooked steaks, brats, burgers and ribs, and everything has turned out with just the right temperature and done-ness.

The only negative for me on this grill is the installation of the bluetooth temperature probe. It is not a 5 minute install as it should be, and there are screws that you have to take out to install the electronics pack, that you need a mirror to locate.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
1. The grill plates are too high above the flavorizer bars to get a good sear on steaks. If you remove one plate, turn the other 90 degrees and place directly on the bars, the steaks will sear in that position. In the normal position, this "grill" works more like an oven because the grill plates are 2 inches too high above the bars.
2. The wheels are cheap plastic.  I plan on keeping my grill on the deck over winter.  I think that one freeze and thaw winter will cause them to crack. Just rolling them down my old but relatively smooth driveway really took a lot of chunks out of them.  Would be better with metal wheels with rubber rims.
3. The propane bottle scale is a good idea but the tank rests directly on the axel. So the scale will not work until the tank is almost empty and lifts off of the axel. Trying to figure a way around this by using bolts to push the tank further away from the axel.
4. Finally, the entire unit is difficult to move because there are no good hand grips on the left side to lift the unit and push it.  The left sided, collapsible shelf is there, but it is too flimsy to lift the grill off the ground and push it to move or re-position it.
Results.Title: Could be better.
